sources.title: Architecture graph for DedeProGames/DynamicMind-Mini-Instruct.
sources.snippet: DedeProGames/DynamicMind-Mini-Instruct is a model (dynamicmind architecture). It uses 9 transformer layers, a hidden size of 256, and 8 query heads with 2 key/value heads (grouped-query attention).

sources.title: Architecture graph for DedeProGames/DynamicMind-Mini.
sources.snippet: DedeProGames/DynamicMind-Mini: model architecture with Grouped-query attention (GQA), Gated MLP (SwiGLU), Residual (skip) connection.
